abstract: Maintains quayside staging berth reservations and mobilization timelines
system_message:
You are the Port logistics coordinator (LOGS), responsible for maintaining quayside staging berth reservations and mobilization timelines as well as heavy-lift crane utilization for subsea survey vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Heavy-lift crane utilization（CRANE）
information_points.content:
LOGS-CRANE-KZY：According to the port equipment manifest, the assigned mobilization berth crane for the Towed deep-tow synthetic aperture sonar track provides a quayside crane hook load capacity with a maximum certified working load limit of 50 t.
LOGS-CRANE-D7I：According to the port equipment manifest, the assigned mobilization berth crane for the Autonomous underwater vehicle bathymetric sweep provides a quayside crane hook load capacity with a maximum certified working load limit of 35 t.
LOGS-CRANE-I6X：According to the port equipment manifest, the assigned mobilization berth crane for the Remotely operated subsea crawler grid survey provides a quayside crane hook load capacity with a maximum certified working load limit of 20 t.

information_points.title: Maintains quayside staging berth reservations and mobilization timelines（WHRF）
information_points.content:
LOGS-WHRF-NMW：For the Remotely operated subsea crawler grid survey, harbor berth operational estimates indicate a quayside mobilization turnaround time of 6 d for pre-departure sensor rigging and wet-testing before vessel departure.
LOGS-WHRF-ZFF：For the Autonomous underwater vehicle bathymetric sweep, harbor berth operational estimates indicate a quayside mobilization turnaround time of 6 d for pre-departure sensor rigging and wet-testing before vessel departure.
LOGS-WHRF-KAQ：For the Towed deep-tow synthetic aperture sonar track, harbor berth operational estimates indicate a quayside mobilization turnaround time of 2 d for pre-departure sensor rigging and wet-testing before vessel departure.
